summary: This Form 8-K reports an increase in the maximum principal amount of a March 2026 convertible note financing from $2M to $3M and the first closing under the new securities purchase agreement, issuing $500K in unsecured convertible notes and warrants to purchase 50K shares at $1.75 per share. The proceeds will be used for working capital. The notes bear 10% PIK interest and convert at maturity. This is a routine capital raise and not a special-situation event. No change in control, premium, or board conflict exists.
